name: slid-phi-labs
title: Slid Phi Labs
description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP for Slid Phi Labs public catalog and commerce discovery. Lookup is public; engines and customer operations remain protected.

tools.name: cuni_bank
tools.description: Run a CuNi program through CuNi Bank: submit source in Python or .cuni and get the exact output in the target language, or a refusal when the languages disagree. Read-only computation — no state is stored. Calls the CuNi Studio service (cuni-studio.fly.dev). Use for exactness checks and cross-language proofs; use spl_compress for byte compression, not program translation.

source.description: Source program to run: a Python v1-subset program or .cuni source text.

from.description: Source language: py for a Python v1-subset program, cuni for .cuni source. Defaults to py.

to.description: Target language for the output, e.g. js, go, ts, py. Required.

tools.name: spl_discover
tools.description: List the lab's lead and cash products, auth endpoints, and entry points (site, CuNi Studio, Agent-Rider, Chamber, MCP, x402, SKILL.md). Read-only; returns a static discovery map. Takes no arguments. Use as the first call when orienting an agent; use the *_search catalog tools for prices and details.

tools.name: spl_lab_auth
tools.description: Explain how to mint a lab account or agent API key: the human signup/login flow and the agent_key call. Read-only; returns instructions only and creates nothing. Takes no arguments. Use to learn the auth flow; use spl_signup to create a human account or spl_agent_key to mint a key.

tools.name: spl_signup
tools.description: Create a human lab account with an email and password. Mutating: stores a salted password hash and returns a signed session token. Email must be a valid address, password at least 8 characters; duplicate emails are rejected. Use for a human seat; use spl_agent_key for a passwordless agent key.

email.description: Account email address. Must be a valid email; duplicates are rejected with email_taken.

password.description: Account password, at least 8 characters. Stored as a salted hash, never in plain text.

name.description: Display name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to the part of the email before @.

tools.name: spl_agent_key
tools.description: Mint a passwordless agent API key (spl_ag_*) for a named agent. Mutating: creates an agent account and returns the key once — store it, it cannot be retrieved again. Use for agent seats; use spl_signup for a human account with email and password.

name.description: Agent name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to agent.

tools.name: spl_catalog
tools.description: List the standing SKUs agents can buy via x402 (live product list from /api/x402-products). Read-only; returns current prices and payment rails. Takes no arguments. Use for live purchase options; use sku_search and sku_get for the catalog's price notes and links.

tools.name: spl_compress
tools.description: Compress bytes with the hosted lossless engine (PCC and sibling codecs). Accepts base64 input; returns base64 packed bytes, sizes, and the method used. Read-only computation — nothing is stored. Metered: first 1 GB free once per IP, then $0.25/GB; a paid seat or x402 payment may be required (402). Use to shrink data; use spl_decompress to restore it, spl_zip to pack files.

data_b64.description: Base64-encoded bytes to compress. Must be valid base64.

tools.name: spl_decompress
tools.description: Restore bytes packed by spl_compress. Accepts the base64 packed output; returns the original bytes as base64 plus their length. Read-only computation — nothing is stored. Use only on output from spl_compress; use spl_unzip for .pcc archives.

packed_b64.description: Base64-encoded packed bytes previously returned by spl_compress.

tools.name: spl_zip
tools.description: Pack files into a .pcc archive (the lab's zip). Each file is compressed with the hosted engine; returns the archive as base64 plus packed size and member count. Read-only computation — nothing is stored. Use to bundle multiple files; use spl_compress for a single blob, spl_unzip to restore.

files.description: Files to pack. Each item: path (archive path), data_b64 (base64 file bytes; omit for directories), dir (true for a directory entry).

path.description: Path inside the archive, e.g. notes/readme.txt.

data_b64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes. Omit for directory entries.

dir.description: True when this entry is a directory (no bytes). Defaults to false.

tools.name: spl_unzip
tools.description: Restore files from a .pcc archive made by spl_zip. Accepts the archive as base64; returns each file with path and base64 bytes plus the member count. Read-only computation — nothing is stored. Use only on .pcc archives; use spl_decompress for single blobs from spl_compress.

packed_b64.description: Base64-encoded .pcc archive previously returned by spl_zip.

tools.name: spl_quote
tools.description: Quote a metered PCC job before running it: price in USD for the given byte count, product, and operation. Read-only and free; returns the quote without charging or reserving anything. First 1 GB free once per IP, then $0.25/GB of input, $1 card minimum. Use before spl_compress on large inputs; use spl_catalog for standing SKUs.

bytes.description: Payload bytes. First 1 GB free once per IP.

product.description: Product to price: auto, zrw, blackjack, shard-zip, shard-tsdb, or slid-phi. Defaults to auto.

op.description: Operation: compress, decompress, or roundtrip. Defaults to compress.

dataClass.description: Data class of the payload (e.g. text, logs, json) when known; used to pick the best product. Defaults to unknown.

tools.name: spl_research
tools.description: Default web search (Tavily). Fresh sources for any agent run. Args: query (required), max_results (1-10, default 5), search_depth (basic|advanced, default basic), include_answer (default false). Lab-metered; refuses closed when TAVILY_API_KEY is unset.

tools.name: spl_warrant_issue
tools.description: Issue a Warrant (spend mandate) for an Agent-Rider identity, capping what an agent may spend, where, and for how long. Mutating: mints a signed token. Pass a Rider JWT, or demo:true for a 10-minute shape check that issues nothing billable. Use to authorize an agent's spending before it acts; use spl_warrant_verify to check a token, spl_warrant_reserve to hold funds, spl_warrant_receipt to settle.

rider.description: Agent-Rider JWT proving the identity the Warrant is issued for. Required unless demo is true.

demo.description: True for a 10-minute shape check without a Rider token. Defaults to false.

actions.description: Allowed action names, e.g. ["compress", "quote"]. Omit for no action restriction.

allow_hosts.description: Allowed hostnames the agent may call. Omit for no host restriction.

max_usd.description: Maximum spend in USD across the Warrant's life. Omit for no cap.

max_calls.description: Maximum number of calls under this Warrant. Omit for no cap.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds. Demo defaults to 600 (10 minutes).

tools.name: spl_warrant_verify
tools.description: Verify a Warrant token and check it against an optional host, action, and USD cost — pass usd to enforce the spend cap BEFORE the job runs. Read-only; verifies locally and changes nothing. Returns valid true/false with the Warrant or a reason. Use before running a job under a Warrant; use spl_warrant_issue to mint one.

warrant.description: Warrant token string to verify. Required.

host.description: Hostname the job will call; checked against the Warrant's allow list when given.

action.description: Action name the job will perform; checked against the Warrant's allowed actions when given.

usd.description: Expected USD cost of the job; checked against the remaining spend cap when given.

tools.name: spl_warrant_reserve
tools.description: Reserve the expected cost against a Warrant BEFORE the job runs (pre-spend cap enforcement). Mutating: holds funds and returns a reservation id. File the receipt with that id to settle without double-deducting, or release it if the job never runs. Use after verify and before the job; use spl_warrant_receipt to settle, spl_warrant_release to refund.

warrant.description: Warrant token to reserve against. Required.

host.description: Hostname the job will call; checked against the Warrant's allow list when given.

action.description: Action name the job will perform; checked against the Warrant's allowed actions when given.

usd.description: USD cost to hold. Required for the reservation.

tools.name: spl_warrant_release
tools.description: Refund an unsettled Warrant reservation when the job never ran. Mutating: frees the held funds; the reservation cannot be used afterward. Use only for reservations that will never settle; use spl_warrant_receipt to settle a completed job.

reservation_id.description: Reservation id returned by spl_warrant_reserve. Required.

tools.name: spl_warrant_receipt
tools.description: File a receipt against a Warrant after an action, settling the spend. Mutating: deducts the USD cost — pass the reservation id from spl_warrant_reserve to settle against the reservation instead of deducting twice. Use after a job completes; use spl_warrant_reserve before it runs.

warrant.description: Warrant token the receipt is filed against. Required.

action.description: Action name that ran, e.g. compress.

usd.description: USD cost to deduct. Required for settlement.

reservation_id.description: Reservation id from spl_warrant_reserve, when the cost was pre-reserved. Settles against the reservation instead of deducting twice.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the request body, for the audit trail.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the result body, for the audit trail.

note.description: Free-text note attached to the receipt.

tools.name: spl_agentic_plan
tools.description: Plan one Agent Commerce Network (ACN) run without executing it: validate the run shape across Rider, Warrant, Tollkeeper, Quikgater, PCC, AWLpay, PSI, and Conductor, plus any optional stage whose spec field is present. Pure and read-only — no disk, no network, nothing is charged or started. Returns the planned stages, quote, and settlement preview. Use to dry-run a run before spl_agentic_run; use spl_agentic_context to shrink the context a run will carry.

action.description: Run action or stage name, e.g. plan, compress, or a stage key. Determines which stages the plan includes.

bytes.description: Input byte count the run will process; used for the quote.

demo.description: True to plan or run a demo with no payment and no Rider token.

rider.description: Agent-Rider JWT identifying the acting agent. Required for live runs unless demo is true.

crossing.description: Crossing or bridge identifier when the run moves between systems.

rail.description: Payment rail: stripe for humans, x402 for agents.

swap.description: Swap details for a cross-chain step (from/to chain, token, amount).

cuni.description: CuNi program or exactness input for the run.

warrantTemplate.description: Warrant template to apply to the run; string id or object.

standingRider.description: Standing Rider credential for the run; string id or object.

reputation.description: Reputation input for the run; string id or object.

tool.description: Tool call spec for the run.

agent.description: Agent spec for the run; string id or object.

message.description: Message payload for an agent-messaging stage.

privateBench.description: Private benchmark input for the run.

solana.description: Solana transaction input for the run.

audit.description: Audit or audit-export input; string id or object.

asyncRun.description: Async run spec for the run.

sandbox.description: Sandbox spec for an isolated step.

depotReceipt.description: Depot receipt input for the run.

depotBilling.description: Depot billing input for the run.

conductorTask.description: Conductor task spec; string id or object.

conductorReview.description: Conductor review input for the run.

mcpTool.description: MCP tool call spec for the run.

sku.description: SKU to buy or price; string id or object.

tokenBudget.description: Token budget for the run; string id or object.

depotStore.description: Depot store input for the run.

chamberSeal.description: Chamber seal input for the run.

riderPaidCall.description: Paid Rider call input for the run.

tools.name: spl_agentic_context
tools.description: Shrink LLM context extractively before a run: BM25-lite filtering, cross-encoder reranking, and dedup, verified by construction, with a quote on input bytes. Read-only computation; the text is not stored. Use to fit a long context into a run's budget; use spl_agentic_plan to shape the run itself.

query.description: Query the kept context must answer; guides the reranker. Omit to keep the most central passages.

targetRatio.description: Target compression ratio between 0.01 and 1, e.g. 0.25 keeps roughly a quarter of the input. Omit for the default.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens per chunk and in the compressed output.

reranker.description: Reranker tier: MiniLM-L-6-v2 by default, bge-reranker-v2-gemma as the opt-in quality tier.

rerankTopK.description: How many top BM25 candidates the reranker rescores. Omit to rescore every candidate.

used_bytes.description: Bytes already consumed, counted toward the quote.

sku.description: SKU to quote the context work against.

tools.name: spl_agentic_run
tools.description: Execute one Agent Commerce Network (ACN) run. Mutating: runs paid and unpaid steps; unpaid steps answer 402 (payment required) instead of running. Requires confirm:true plus demo:true or a Rider + Warrant pair. Use after spl_agentic_plan validates the shape; use spl_agentic_context first when the context is large.

action.description: Run action or stage name, e.g. plan, compress, or a stage key. Determines which stages the plan includes.

bytes.description: Input byte count the run will process; used for the quote.

demo.description: True to plan or run a demo with no payment and no Rider token.

rider.description: Agent-Rider JWT identifying the acting agent. Required for live runs unless demo is true.

warrant.description: Warrant token authorizing the run's spending. Required for live runs unless demo is true.

crossing.description: Crossing or bridge identifier when the run moves between systems.

pay.description: True to pay for paid steps when they are reached.

paid.description: True when payment was already made for this run.

rail.description: Payment rail: stripe for humans, x402 for agents.

swap.description: Swap details for a cross-chain step (from/to chain, token, amount).

x_payment.description: X-PAYMENT header value for x402 settlement.

debridge.description: deBridge swap input for a cross-chain step.

chain.description: Receipt chain for the run; array of prior receipts.

parent_receipt.description: Parent receipt id when this run continues another run.

cuni.description: CuNi program or exactness input for the run.

warrantTemplate.description: Warrant template to apply to the run; string id or object.

standingRider.description: Standing Rider credential for the run; string id or object.

reputation.description: Reputation input for the run; string id or object.

tool.description: Tool call spec for the run.

agent.description: Agent spec for the run; string id or object.

message.description: Message payload for an agent-messaging stage.

privateBench.description: Private benchmark input for the run.

solana.description: Solana transaction input for the run.

audit.description: Audit or audit-export input; string id or object.

asyncRun.description: Async run spec for the run.

sandbox.description: Sandbox spec for an isolated step.

depotReceipt.description: Depot receipt input for the run.

depotBilling.description: Depot billing input for the run.

conductorTask.description: Conductor task spec; string id or object.

conductorReview.description: Conductor review input for the run.

mcpTool.description: MCP tool call spec for the run.

sku.description: SKU to buy or price; string id or object.

tokenBudget.description: Token budget for the run; string id or object.

depotStore.description: Depot store input for the run.

chamberSeal.description: Chamber seal input for the run.

riderPaidCall.description: Paid Rider call input for the run.

confirm.description: True to execute the run. Required — without it the run is refused.

tools.name: sku_search
tools.description: Search the Prices catalog by free text — PCC Pro, Chamber, Rider seats, Lab Pass, consulting, and OSS support. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use sku_get when you already know the entry id.

tools.name: sku_get
tools.description: Retrieve one Prices catalog entry by its id, e.g. pcc-pro, chamber-month, rider-team. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use sku_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.
